title: Student Survey Advisory Group Member
bio: Tirth Dave is a senior at Harvard College studying Economics and Government. He is originally from Burke, Virginia, but now lives in Quincy House. In addition to the Student Survey Advisory Group, he is on the Club Lacrosse team, was a manager for The Harvard Crimson Business Board, and is involved with research. He enjoys providing student feedback to ensure the surveys that the DSO puts out lead to meaningful change.
